title: Hermes Agent desktop app released by Nous Research
summary: Nous Research released an open-source native desktop app for Hermes Agent, providing a GUI to manage profiles, skills, memory, providers, cron jobs and gateways for the persistent self-evolving agent. Cross-platform installers are available for Windows, macOS and Linux.

research.description: The agent that grows with you - a persistent autonomous system with long-term memory, reusable skills and a closed self-improvement loop.
